I can do that. To proceed, please share the statements or specify how to fetch them, plus a few preferences so I can flag duplicates and price increases accurately:

Data sources and access
- How will you provide the statements? (Upload PDFs, CSVs, or paste text.)
- Which accounts/cards should I include? (Bank/credit card names and last 4 digits, if multiple.)
- Time range to audit? (e.g., last 12 months)
- Currency to report in? (e.g., USD)

Parsing preferences
- Include both monthly and annual subscriptions (annuals normalized to monthly)?
- Include taxes/fees in the subscription cost, or base price only?
- Treat Apple/Google/PayPal aggregator charges as subscriptions if descriptors match? (Y/N)

Duplicates criteria
- What counts as a duplicate for you?
  • Same provider, multiple plans (e.g., Spotify Individual + Family)
  • Overlapping services across providers (e.g., YouTube Premium vs. YT Music)
  • Same service via different billing channels (e.g., Hulu via Apple and direct)
- If found, should I prefer the lowest-cost plan or the one with higher features?

Price increase rules
- What window counts as “recent” for the badge? (e.g., last 6 months)
- Minimum change to flag? (e.g., ≥5% or ≥$1)

Usage estimation
- OK to infer usage from transaction recency/frequency only, or do you have actual usage logs to provide?
- Any subscriptions you already know are low-use?

Output and cancellations
- Include cancel links/domains when detectable from descriptors? (display-only)
- Show a savings calculator for 1, 3, and 12 months?

If you’re ready, please upload or paste your statements (PDF/CSV/text). For CSV, headers like date, description, amount, currency help. For PDFs/text, ensure transaction date, merchant/descriptor, and amount are visible.
